svg.text: Read paths (search, listing) are cached and horizontally scaled; the booking write path is strongly consistent; everything else reacts to events.
each service owns its own store; no shared tables
hold dates in Redis (10 min TTL) → quote from Pricing → PSP authorise →
insert booking (Postgres exclusion constraint) → capture → BookingConfirmed event
called through adapters with retries + circuit breakers
keeps OpenSearch in sync within seconds
HPA on CPU/RPS, 3 AZs per region,
SLOs on search p95 and booking success
secrets in KMS/Vault, PCI scope isolated
